capabilities: Create and open inbox, week, today, tomorrow, and yesterday todo notes
Move the task under the cursor to the next working day
Move tasks to the inbox or any date document via a modal
Add new todos to the inbox or a specific date document
Configure the set of working days used for date navigation
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not a calendar or weekly overview; it manages todo documents for inbox, week, and individual days and moves tasks between them.
motivation: The author built it to reflect his personal working process organized around three ideas: Inbox, Week, and Today.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in workflow for triaging an unordered inbox of todos into daily and weekly planning notes.
summary: Task planner that creates inbox, week, and day todo notes on demand and moves tasks between them via commands.
